# Schematic

Schematic is a browser workspace for planning connected hardware projects. It keeps component identities, modeled connections, editable source, graph checks, outcome previews, and sourcing tied to one active project.

## Primary pages

- [Home](/)
- [Studio](/studio)
- [Parts desk](/parts)
- [Workspace settings](/settings)

## Core capabilities

- Place real hardware components from the catalog
- Connect typed hardware interfaces
- Edit and export project source
- Run project graph checks
- Inspect plan-driven outcome previews
- Review supplier candidates before adding listings to the build cart
